notes.title: 40% discount started!
notes.content:
[h3]Discount[/h3]
Due to technical reasons, we were unable to launch the discount during the game's release, but now it is launched!
[h3]Deadlines[/h3]
[b]40% discount[/b] will be valid [b]from October 31 to November 7[/b], giving you a wonderful opportunity to purchase it at a very competitive price to enjoy beautiful girls on top of any applications and games!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310390/e8596c7fe4f825349ae231d6f5496f678b43db9c.gif[/img]

We also really appreciate your feedback in the form of reviews, discussions or comments, so don't be shy :)

[h3]Raffle[/h3]
In addition, we are starting a draw for [b]75 keys[/b] for our games in our Steam group:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GosDev/discussions/0/3875969933563779465/
To participate, you must also subscribe to our curatorial group:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev
For all questions and suggestions, write to GosDevProduction@gmail.com.
